create_LCMConfig: create an LCMConfig dataclass to hold model card, encoder, decoder, and generator batch size settings for LCM evaluation
build_LCMPredictor_from_config: build an LCMPredictor instance from an LCMConfig using the from_config class method with optional kwargs
run_LCMPredictor_call: run the LCMPredictor call method with text or embedding prompts to generate sequence predictions with configurable generation parameters
review_LCMPredictor_format_predictions: review the LCMPredictor format_predictions method to extract text, embeddings, and logprobs from LCM generator output
test_LCMPredictor_encoder: test the LCMPredictor cached encoder property that returns a TextToEmbeddingModelPipeline for encoding input text to embeddings
